title: Single-Cell Mapping and 3D Tissue Reconstruction using Cryosection-derived Images and Tissue Mapper software
protocol: Have Tissue Mapper installed and licensed on your workstation.
Set an API key to pull the ontology list from SciCrunch in Tissue Mapper.
Open the Tissue Mapper program.
Click FILE -> OPEN -> IMAGE STACK.
Locate the block face images and select all images for the image stack.
Click Open after selecting the images.
Rearrange the order of the images if necessary by dragging them into place.
Confirm the order by clicking OK.
Insert appropriate X, Y, and Z scaling values in the Image Scaling window.
Save the image stack as a JPX file.
Create a blank annotation file in XML format and link it to the JPX image stack.
Drag and drop the annotation XML file into the blank display screen.
Ensure the "Load Images with Data File" check box is selected.
Select “Begin” in the Welcome Screen to start the process.
Edit Subject information and Criteria for anatomic terms if necessary.
Click on the Trace Tab within Tissue Mapper.
Within CONTOURS section, select the appropriate anatomical term from the drop down menu.
Within CONTOURS section, select “Freehand” mode.
Right-click on the image to start continuous tracing.
Left-click and drag the mouse to draw a contour on the image.
Select “Close” from the CONTOURS section to close the drawn contour.
Turn down the transparency of the tissue image and overlay it over the block face image to get a best alignment, possibly by adjusting the image sizes.
Begin to mark the samples directly onto the images once an appropriate alignment is achieved.
Account for any distortion that may have occurred due to tissue mounting, dehydration, and staining processes when aligning the tissue section image with the block face image.
Use the annotated block face image with markers as a guide in Tissue Mapper.
Select a marker to represent cells of interest from the Markers toolbar.
Pan and zoom the block face image in Tissue Mapper to identify regions corresponding to cell locations.
Click on the location to place a marker for each cell or feature of interest.
Repeat marking until all cells of interest are marked across the stack.
Select all contours and markers on the first section using “Select objects”.
Do not use “select all” to avoid moving every contour in the entire stack simultaneously.
Show current section in Serial Section Manager to display all contours within the stack.
Right click on the block face image and select “Move selected objects” to align contours and markers with the rest of the contours in the stack.
Deselect the “eye” icon in the Image Organizer window to hide the images in the 3D view to be constructed.
Press the "3D Visualize" icon in the VIEW section to visualize all the contours and markers in the 3D viewer.
